result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: overlapping text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata line, which renders as garbled, unreadable text.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping text ('25–3€0mdeliivery'). The delivery time '25–35 min' and the delivery fee '€0 delivery' are rendered on top of each other, making both values unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout so the metadata items ('25–35 min', '€0 delivery', 'Ramen') are laid out sequentially with proper spacing/separators (e.g., a horizontal flex row with dot dividers) instead of overlapping at the same position.
